description_en: Queries the list of subscribed reports
description_zh: 查看已订阅的报告列表
name: ListReportDefinitions

parameters.help_en: The primary marketplace ID. If this parameter is left empty, the marketplace ID of the current user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 一级售卖场ID，如果为空，默认使用当前用户所属的场ID填充
parameters.name: nbid

Metadata.description_en: The metadata of the response structure

BeginBillingCycle.description_en: The start billing cycle for data push. After a successful subscription, the system automatically pushes data from the start billing cycle to the current time. This parameter is invalid for monthly bill PDF subscriptions and historical data is not pushed again. Data for up to the last year can be pushed
BeginBillingCycle.description_zh: 推送起始账期。订阅成功后，系统会自动推送起始账期到当前时间的数据。月账单PDF订阅时此参数无效，不会对历史数据重新推送。最多可推送最近1年内数据
BeginBillingCycle.title_en: 推送起始账期。订阅成功后，系统会自动推送起始账期到当前时间的数据。月账单PDF订阅时此参数无效，不会对历史数据重新推送。最多可推送最近1年内数据。
BeginBillingCycle.title_zh: 推送起始账期。订阅成功后，系统会自动推送起始账期到当前时间的数据。月账单PDF订阅时此参数无效，不会对历史数据重新推送。最多可推送最近1年内数据。

OssBucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket where files are stored

OssBucketOwnerAccountId.description_en: The UID of the OSS bucket owner. Specify this parameter if the subscription is made by a bidder or reseller and data needs to be pushed to the OSS bucket of a RAM user. The target account must be a RAM user of the calling account and must be granted the AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole permission. Regular users do not need to specify this parameter. By default, the calling account is used
OssBucketOwnerAccountId.description_zh: 存储文件的Oss Owner对应的UID。如果是Bid/ReSeller订阅，并需要推送到子账号的OSS上时指定，需要此账号为调用账号子账号，并对此账号授予AliyunConsumeDump2OSSRole权限。 普通用户则无需指定，默认为调用账号

OssBucketPath.description_en: The storage path in the OSS bucket

ReportSourceName.description_en: The name of the subscription source

ReportSourceType.description_en: The type of the subscription source, such as OSS or MC

ReportTaskId.description_en: The ID of the bill subscription task

ReportType.description_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:
BillingItemDetailForBillingPeriod: billing item consumption details
InstanceDetailForBillingPeriod: instance consumption details
BillingItemDetailMonthly: billing item consumption summary by billing cycle
ReportType.description_zh:
订阅类型。取值类型：
BillingItemDetailForBillingPeriod：计费项消费明细。
InstanceDetailForBillingPeriod：实例消费明细。
BillingItemDetailMonthly：计费项消费账期汇总

SubscribeCreateTime.description_en: The time when the subscription was created
